description: This module allows you to manage per-locale message overrides for a Keycloak realm using the Keycloak Admin REST API.

parameters.name: auth_client_id
parameters.description: OpenID Connect client_id to authenticate to the API with. Default: "admin-cli"

parameters.name: auth_client_secret
parameters.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with auth_client_id (if required).

parameters.name: auth_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: auth_realm
parameters.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

parameters.name: auth_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API. Default: 10

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: If false, only the keys listed in the overrides are modified by this module. Any other pre-existing keys are ignored. If true, all locale overrides are made to match configuration of this module. For example any keys missing from the overrides are removed regardless of state value. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Locale code for which the overrides apply (for example, en, fi, de).

parameters.name: overrides
parameters.description: List of overrides to ensure for the locale when state=present. Each item is a mapping with the record’s overrides[].key and its overrides[].value. Ignored when state=absent. Default: []

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Name of the realm that owns the locale overrides.

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Desired state of localization overrides for the given locale. On present, the set of overrides for the locale are made to match overrides. If force is true keys not listed in overrides are removed, and the listed keys are created or updated. If force is false keys not listed in overrides are ignored, and the listed keys are created or updated. On absent, overrides for the locale is removed. If force is true, all keys are removed. If force is false, only the keys listed in overrides are removed. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Replace all overrides for locale "en" (credentials auth)
  community.general.keycloak_realm_localization:
    auth_client_id: admin-cli
    auth_keycloak_url: https://auth.example.com/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: USERNAME
    auth_password: PASSWORD
    parent_id: my-realm
    locale: en
    state: present
    force: true
    overrides:
      - key: greeting
        value: "Hello"
      - key: farewell
        value: "Bye"
  delegate_to: localhost

- name: Replace listed overrides for locale "en" (credentials auth)
  community.general.keycloak_realm_localization:
    auth_client_id: admin-cli
    auth_keycloak_url: https://auth.example.com/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: USERNAME
    auth_password: PASSWORD
    parent_id: my-realm
    locale: en
    state: present
    force: false
    overrides:
      - key: greeting
        value: "Hello"
      - key: farewell
        value: "Bye"
  delegate_to: localhost

- name: Ensure only one override exists for locale "fi" (token auth)
  community.general.keycloak_realm_localization:
    auth_client_id: admin-cli
    auth_keycloak_url: https://auth.example.com/auth
    token: TOKEN
    parent_id: my-realm
    locale: fi
    state: present
    force: true
    overrides:
      - key: app.title
        value: "Sovellukseni"
  delegate_to: localhost

- name: Remove all overrides for locale "de"
  community.general.keycloak_realm_localization:
    auth_client_id: admin-cli
    auth_keycloak_url: https://auth.example.com/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: USERNAME
    auth_password: PASSWORD
    parent_id: my-realm
    locale: de
    state: absent
    force: true
  delegate_to: localhost

- name: Remove only the listed overrides for locale "de"
  community.general.keycloak_realm_localization:
    auth_client_id: admin-cli
    auth_keycloak_url: https://auth.example.com/auth
    auth_realm: master
    auth_username: USERNAME
    auth_password: PASSWORD
    parent_id: my-realm
    locale: de
    state: absent
    force: false
    overrides:
      - key: app.title
      - key: foo
      - key: bar
  delegate_to: localhost

return_values.name: end_state
return_values.description: Final state of localization overrides for the locale after module execution. Contains the locale and the list of overrides as key/value items. Returned: on success

return_values.name: locale
return_values.description: The locale code affected. Returned: success Sample: "en"

return_values.name: overrides
return_values.description: The list of overrides that exist after execution. Returned: success Sample: [{"key": "greeting", "value": "Hello"}, {"key": "farewell", "value": "Bye"}]
